name: Wikipedia
summary:
Wikipedia’s favicon is the mark wikipedia.org sends with encyclopedia pages. This page lists link tags found in the HTML and any icon file those tags, or a well-known icon path, actually downloaded. The puzzle-globe artwork is shown for reference.

Checked 12 November 2026 against wikipedia.org. HTML came from https://www.wikipedia.org/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: apple-touch-icon → https://www.wikipedia.org/static/apple-touch/wikipedia.png; shortcut icon → https://www.wikipedia.org/static/favicon/wikipedia.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.wikipedia.org/static/favicon/wikipedia.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 2734 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.wikipedia.org/static/apple-touch/wikipedia.png, measured at 160×160 png.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: png-160x160-01.png at 160×160 (png, 1313 bytes) from https://www.wikipedia.org/static/apple-touch/wikipedia.png.
